description: The CNAEs (activity codes) that usually win procurements like this one, most likely first, with the official description and, per CNAE, how many items and how much of the estimated value pointed to it. Free. Each item of the procurement (up to 99, the ones of highest value) points to the 3 most likely CNAEs, by a classifier trained on the activity of the companies that won similar items in the awarded PNCP results; the procurement adds the points (3, 2 and 1 by position). Without items in the collection, the object of the procurement counts, and the top 5 come without `itens` or `valor_estimado`. In the measurement of 27/09/2026, for 87% of the items one of the first 3 was a CNAE of the company that won. To receive the new procurements of these CNAEs, create an alert (`POST /api/alertas`).
